title: Simultaneous common-stage representatives and their comparison images
statement:
Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set, let $\mathcal C_i$ and $\mathcal D$ be categories, and let $(T_{ij},\Phi_i,\theta_{ij},\tau_{ijk})$ be a coherent normalized cocone with category $\mathcal C_\infty$, transition maps $t_{kl}$ and comparison functor $\Phi$ as defined in [det-def-sfb-filtered-two-colimit-model]. All indexing sets and Hom sets are sets in fixed sufficiently large universes. Fix $a=(i,x)$ and $b=(j,y)$ in $\mathcal C_\infty$.

For every pair $f,h:a\to b$ there exist $m\ge i,j$ and morphisms $u,v:T_{im}x\to T_{jm}y$ of $\mathcal C_m$ such that $f=[m,u]$ and $h=[m,v]$.

For every such common-stage representation, one has
$$\Phi(f)=\Phi(h)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\Phi_m(u)=\Phi_m(v).$$
More specifically, given representatives $f=[k,g]$, $h=[l,g']$ and any $m\ge k,l$, the morphisms $u=t_{km}(g)$ and $v=t_{lm}(g')$ have these properties.
